title: Περὶ συνθέσεως φαρμάκων τῶν κατὰ γένη — De compositione medicamentorum per genera (Composition of Drugs according to Kinds); RU: Гален, «О составлении лекарств по родам»
author: Galen of Pergamon
size: 7 books, Kühn XIII 362–1058; c. 102,000 words (Zainaldin et al. 2026)
edition: Only Kühn 1827 (Greek and Latin, public domain); no modern critical edition (Zainaldin et al. 2026; Fichtner no. 82).
ru_evidence: Not in the ru.wikipedia Galen translation list; the Balalykin series focuses on philosophical and anatomical works (vols II–V contents not fully verified).
en_evidence: Zainaldin et al. 2026: Comp. gen. 'has never been translated into English'. Fichtner bibliography (no. 82) lists no translation in any language.
value: Recipe book quoting many Hellenistic and early imperial pharmacologists: evidence for drug trade, pharmaceutical practice and lost authors. A methodological showcase, since a published LLM benchmark on this very text exists.
ai_feasibility: low-medium: Zainaldin et al. report mean 79.9/100, bimodal, with catastrophic failures on dense recipes but c. 95 on expository passages. Needs a term lexicon and pharmacological review.
pilot_unit: Book I (theory plus the first plaster groups), est. c. 15k words; the benchmark's 10 passages serve as a test set
